parsed.review_summary: The candidate edit correctly addresses all three error targets. It fixes the evidence misread by acknowledging that the comment names specific missing results (A-DDIM, PNDM, and quantitative results on non-CIFAR-10 datasets) and directs them to the main text. It corrects the factual error by recognizing that datasets and content are explicitly identified. It fixes the rubric misapplication by stating the comment fits the highest rubric level (explicit action with concrete implementation details) without directly stating a numeric score. Unrelated correct reasoning about the comment being an explicit suggestion is preserved, and no evidence is invented.
